exposure: INTERGROWTH-21st Newborn Cross-Sectional Study (NCSS) chart standards
outcome: prevalence of Small for Gestational Age (SGA)
prevalence of Large for Gestational Age (LGA)
finding: Chinese birth size charts for infants born after uncomplicated pregnancies differed from INTERGROWTH-21st charts, resulting in varying classifications of newborns for SGA and LGA prevalence.
